date_last_updated.why: Clearing 2026-08-02 is correct: a partial commencement, not an amendment.

date_in_force.why: The quotes show the Gazette date from the Maltese text header and the ELI page title; neither states entry into force, but regulation 1(3) defers only regulations 5 to 7 and 9 to 12 to 2 August 2026, and the ELI metadata gives 10 October 2025.

summary_claims.claim: Designation of the Commissioner as market surveillance authority for listed high-risk systems

Penalty cap EUR 50,000 per infringement plus EUR 50 a day for public bodies; appeal to the Information and Data Protection Appeals Tribunal. Literal Maltese-to-English: 'Appeal shall be made to the Information and Data Protection Appeals Tribunal from any decision taken by the Commissioner.'

note: English PDF, Maltese PDF and ELI page stored. Title, enabling article 33 of the Data Protection Act, L.N. 227 of 2025 and the commencement rule confirmed; the Gazette header appears only on the Maltese text. No 2026 amendment found.
